text:
Maya (Marketing): Heads-up: spin up a 72-hour blitz to ship a small OSS refapp, a benchmark post, and a 3-min demo clip. Primary channels: blog, Twitter, developer newsletter.
Ravi (DevRel): Love it. What should repo include? Quickstart + 1-click deploy + benchmark script?
Tess (Engineering): Yes. I'll add a minimal Dockerfile, a run_bench.sh, and a tiny 4-bit quantized model example. Benchscript will output a CSV and a short summary in README.
Sam (Content): I'll own the blog and copy. Need a clear narrative: "how we measured latency & cost" + short methodology. Keep it under 700 words.
Jordan (Product): Messaging: emphasize "start in under 5 mins" and "predictable cost with Dedicated" — two CTAs. Also include a short table comparing hosted vs dedicated cost for this workload.
Nora (Ops): For lead capture: gate the demo bundle behind the signup, tag in HubSpot as "oss-refapp-blitz" and route to devcontent. I'll create the form and webhook.
Maya (Marketing): Timeline proposal: repo and demo by Wed EOD, blog draft Thu morning, video Thu afternoon, social copy Fri. Can folks commit?
Tess (Engineering): I can get the repo + bench results by Wed evening. I'll post sample outputs like:
```
latency_ms, tokens, cost_usd
12.4, 256, 0.0021
18.9, 512, 0.0038
```
Ravi (DevRel): I'll add a short SDK snippet for Redwood API and an example routing policy comment in the README:
```
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'open-small-q4', prompt: 'Summarize...' })
```
Sam (Content): Also want a short how-to note on using batching + caching tips. Can someone give a 3-bullet list I can paste?
Tess (Engineering): 3 bullets: 1) set batch=8 for midburst, 2) enable prefix cache for repeated system prompts, 3) use quantized variant for lower memory.
Maya (Marketing): Nice. For the demo clip: show cloning the repo, running bench, and seeing the endpoint call. Keep it 2.5 minutes. @assets-bot can we get a hero image placeholder?
assets-bot: Uploaded placeholder OG image to /marketing/assets/oss-blitz-hero.png
Nora (Ops): Reminder: ensure the downloadable bundle strips any internal keys and includes a config.example. Also add a short privacy blurb for onboarding.
Ravi (DevRel): I'll prepare two CTAs for the repo: "Try locally in 5 minutes" and "Request Dedicated sizing" linking to the HubSpot form.
Sam (Content): I'll draft email subject lines: "New: Tiny refapp + benchmarks for cheap inference" or "Ship inference features faster with this refapp". Will iterate.
Jordan (Product): Quick check: metrics we publish — latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, estimated $/1M tokens. Keep methodology transparent.
Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Let's reconvene Fri 11am if needed. I'll update the Notion checklist and assign tasks. Thanks everyone! :tada:
